_doc: Numbers for the HUD (Hud.gd) and the Esc menu layout (Settings.gd). HUD sizes are pixels at ref_height and scale with the window height; crosshair maths follows the Source crosshair (YRES = h / 480).

rows.note: dynamic distance += (spread + inaccuracy in rad) x spread_units / tan(fov/2), in YRES units, fov being Source's horizontal fov at 4:3; Hud gets it from the live camera's vertical fov (tan x spread_units / (yres_base/2)), so a changed fov keeps the arms on the spread cone. cl_crosshair_recoil uses the same scale
rows.verified: Source/CS:GO crosshair code as remembered, unverified: not checked against the CS2 client; the maths puts the arm tips on the 4:3 fov 90 spread circle (checked by hand)

rows.note: how fast the dynamic gap eases toward the current spread: each frame closes 1 - exp(-rate x dt) of the distance, so the motion is the same at any frame rate
